scientific_integrity: Self-contained argument using phase reconstruction, Stirling enumeration and Dirac Hamiltonicity; finite independent programs provide checks, not proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only states with exactly one chip per edge, already periodic, and each vertex firing once in the least period are classified; no basin, transient, or multi-firing periodic-state counts. Source-reversal literature remains a historical-priority risk because a closely relevant full text was inaccessible.
title: Exact single-pass orbit census and sharp period interval on complete multipartite chip-firing graphs
